verdict.rationale: Aleph documents a single source of truth that keeps existing financial models in sync. It also offers pull/push sync into Excel and Google Sheets models, versioned forecasts, and automated closing and reporting processes. Together these suggest fresh actuals can flow into an existing model without rebuilding it. However, nothing explicitly describes the forecast re-baselining on closed actuals, such as actuals replacing forecast periods or a rolling forecast after close. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of forecast re-baselining or rolling-forecast behavior triggered by period close, how actuals replace forecast periods in versioned forecasts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
